title: Mawdeep: tighter rooms, prison walls and new props
changes: Rooms in the Mawdeep are smaller and each one has a clear use: cages, pens, butchery, larder, stitching room, lairs. Passages between them are narrower.
Lair gates are now a wall across the passage with only a small gate in it: iron prison bars with a barred gate that winds up, or a stone wall with an iron-bound wooden door that swings open.
New stairs up: real stone steps climbing into a dark arch in the rock.
Redrawn props: braziers on stone plinths, iron cages, butcher's blocks, the stitching slab, stalagmites and bones.
Cave walls have a ragged top edge instead of a straight line.
A second way round the Weaver's loom on the second floor.
